summary: Wide dirt verge backing onto bush and parkland; homes across the road.
reasons: Wide verge, a car already parked

best_section.where: Harts Road south side, on the dirt verge beside the bushy park

drivers.seclusion: South side is bush and open park; nearest houses are across the road, 28 m or more from this section.
drivers.access_and_room: Flat dirt and grass verge beside the lane with a car parked on it; room to pull fully off.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential road; traffic is a flag only as the van stands clear of the lane.
drivers.convention: A car sits on the verge in both images, so parking here is accepted.

flags: No Stopping Any Time sign mapped near the junction end, beyond the best section
sun_shade: Open verge in sun; bush behind gives some afternoon shade from the south-west.
cannot_judge: Exact extent of the no-stopping sign
